## Functions

Simple mean function

```{r}
lazy.mean <- function(x) {
  sum(x) / length(x)
}
```

```{r}
x <- 1:30
```

## optim

`x` is the data set

## Define log likelihood function

```{r}
ll.exp <- function(lambda, x) {
  n <- length(x)
  n * log(lambda) - lambda * sum(x)
}
```

## Define dataset

```{r}
set.seed(4)
data <- rexp(n = 10000, rate = 3)
```


## Find MLE

par = starting vlaue(s) for parameter(s)

```{r}
optim(
  par = 5, # starting parameter
  fn = ll.exp,
  method = "L-BFGS-B", # optimization method
  lower = 1e-6, # lower bound
  control = list(fnscale = -1), # maximize instead of minimize
  x = data
)
```
